notes.body: There are *so many* of these, and the vast, vast majority are converting between plain `char *` and `uint8_t *` (aka `unsigned char *`.)

Is there an (easy) way to enable this by component to help slowly work through this (and prevent it getting worse from smaller components like wsutil and wiretap)? I have seen the numbers from !17821, but the Wformat-truncation errors were down to 2 from 24 a year ago.  Unfortunately I don't have a platform that shows the errors locally, so a long back and forth with CI, it something I'll probably give up quickly on.
I think we can change it compilers flags by component in each directory's CMakeLists.txt if that helps.
I could do this at some point since my main development platform is Linux, but it's not my top priority at the moment.
I think what I'm working towards right now is to fix all warnings not in the dissector directory.  I'm guessing that list is manageable.
If you can do that, we could move adding the `-Wno-pointer-sign` to the `CMakeLists.txt` in the dissector directory, which would be a big step.
